messages:
rae (Docs): Quick PR to modernize the hello-quickstart: replace curl with fetch+AbortController, add a tiny local auth-proxy example for ephemeral tokens, and a short WebSocket snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/15010

omar (Eng): Note runtime param rename: max_output_tokens -> max_tokens. Streaming paths consolidated under /v1/responses/stream. Update SDK call sites too.

liz (DevEx): I'll add the node proxy (one file) and a browser fetch example with AbortController and 8s timeout. Also include CLI one-liner: `rw auth login --ephemeral`. Use env var REDWOOD_EPHEMERAL_TOKEN.

rae (Docs): Good. Add a short "Before you begin" callout: examples assume Hosted API; Dedicated/Private have different hostnames and KMS steps. Bump sample Docker base to node:20-alpine.

ci-bot: preview built: https://deploy-preview-15010--docs.redwood.ai.netlify.app 

omar (Eng): Ran snippet-tests against staging. Fetch+proxy+ws all pass. No regressions.

liz (DevEx): Pushed tiny edits to fix a broken link to /docs/private/onprem -> /docs/private/getting-started. Also updated TS sample: client.responses.create -> client.responses.generate.

rae (Docs): CI green. Merging after one final thumbs.

omar (Eng): Thumbs up from runtime. Merge away.

liz (DevEx): Merged. I'll draft a short changelog entry about the max_output_tokens -> max_tokens swap. :tada:
